source: MAFF General Directorate of Agriculture / CAVAC rice variety catalog for production and export (elibrary source; no clear URL visible on the scanned pages provided)
text: A third independent source (a MAFF/CAVAC catalog of Cambodia's principal rice varieties for production and export) describes IR66 (Ɖច​កក​) as an early-maturing, non-photoperiod-sensitive variety. Reported figures: maturity roughly 105-115 days from sowing to harvest, plant height roughly 80-118 cm, 7-9 productive tillers per hill, panicle length roughly 21-25 cm, around 100-120+ grains per panicle, and yield roughly 3.5-5.8 tonnes/hectare. This is broadly consistent in direction (short duration, non-photoperiod-sensitive, moderate-to-good yield) with IR66 as already described in the KB, and is offered here as a supplementary data point rather than a replacement.
caveat: The source scan had font/encoding corruption similar to other MAFF booklets processed for this KB. Numbers are a best-effort reading and should be treated as illustrative ranges, not exact lookup values.
